narrative.overview: Dark gallery space gives a faceted portrait room to act as a sculpture. Warm stone lettering and clay-copper fields extend its material without adding synthetic crystal decorations. The palette matches an evening viewing scene rather than a generic technology aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed display lettering carries scale; body text stays conversational.
Flat action plaques and disclosure seams, not capability cards.
dos: Do let the existing illustration carry the faceted material.
Do alternate large material fields with readable quiet passages.
donts: Don't add generic capability-card rows or invented social proof.
Don't treat the locally prepared conversation brief as contact delivery.
